procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

orders.reason: worsening right heart failure on furosemide

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Since around November his legs swell higher, his belt is tighter and he feels full after half a plate. Less able to get around - stops twice to the mailbox now. No chest pain. Sleeps in recliner as before, no new orthopnea. Taking furosemide every morning. On O2 2 L.

O: SpO2 93% on 2 L. Weight up ~4 kg from last summer. JVP elevated. Lungs diminished, no crackles. Abdomen mildly full, liver edge palpable. Pitting edema to mid-shin bilaterally.

A/P
Worsening right-sided heart failure/cor pulmonale. Would like cardiology input (echo, ?diuretic plan). Referral placed; they can see him 3/1. BMP and CBC today. Low salt reviewed, daily weights. Call if short of breath at rest.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Per PCP, called pt with Tuesday's labs: kidney function, potassium and blood count stable. Cardiology appt confirmed for 3/1 at 9:00. Pt asked whether to take an extra water pill when swollen - PCP says no, keep 40 mg daily until cardiology weighs in.

reports.text: Sinus rhythm, rate 92. Right axis deviation. Right bundle branch block.
reports.conclusion: Right axis deviation; right bundle branch block.

reports.text: Right ventricle hypertrophied and dilated. Tricuspid regurgitation present. Left ventricle normal in size with normal systolic function. Mitral and aortic valves without significant disease. No pericardial effusion.
reports.conclusion: Right ventricular hypertrophy and dilation with tricuspid regurgitation. Normal left ventricular function.

documents.title: Cardiology consultation
documents.author: cardiology
documents.body:
OUTSIDE CARDIOLOGY GROUP - CONSULTATION
Date of service: 3/1/2024

Referred for worsening right heart failure. Over three months: more leg swelling, abdominal fullness and shrinking exercise tolerance. He denies chest pain and orthopnea.

Medications (per patient): tiotropium, albuterol. Allergies: NKDA.
Social: 45 pack-years, still smoking.

Exam: temp 37.2 C, pulse 92, BP 128/76, RR 20. JVD to 8 cm above the sternal angle. Pitting edema to mid-shins bilaterally. Hepatomegaly. Loud P2. Systolic murmur.

ECG: right axis deviation, right bundle branch block.
TTE today: hypertrophied, dilated right ventricle with tricuspid regurgitation; normal LV function.

Impression: cor pulmonale with tricuspid regurgitation secondary to RV dilation; pulmonary hypertension from COPD.
Recommendations: no change in medications from our side. Continue oxygen. Follow with pulmonary. Return as needed.

documents.title: Cardiology visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Got the cardiology letter. The ultrasound showed the right side of your heart is thickened and enlarged and one valve (the tricuspid) is leaking, which goes with the lung-related heart strain we've been treating. They did not change your medicines. Keep the water pill, oxygen and inhalers as you are, and let me know if the swelling climbs.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Follow-up after cardiology. They found tricuspid regurgitation from the dilated RV; no med changes. Swelling about the same, belly a little full. Breathing at his baseline. Using oxygen. Smoking 1 ppd, 45 pack-years now.

Exam: SpO2 92% on 2 L. JVP up. Holosystolic murmur LLSB. Edema 1+ to shins.

Plan: continue furosemide 40, inhalers, oxygen. BMP today. Pulmonary follow-up as scheduled. Smoking counseling - declines.

reports.text: Stable postoperative changes of the left larynx. No mass or adenopathy.
Hyperinflation. Enlarged main pulmonary artery. No pulmonary nodule or mass. No lymphadenopathy. No effusion.

documents.title: ENT surveillance
documents.author: otolaryngology
documents.body:
OUTSIDE OTOLARYNGOLOGY
Three years after left partial laryngectomy. Scope clean, neck negative. Third and final surveillance CT neck/chest: no recurrence. NED.
Plan: yearly clinic exam with laryngoscopy from here.

documents.title: Refill request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Albuterol MDI and furosemide 40 mg refills, 90 days. Approved per protocol.

documents.title: Dermatology skin check
documents.author: dermatology
documents.body:
OUTSIDE DERMATOLOGY
Yearly skin exam. Came with portable oxygen. Lip scar fine. Sun damage, no suspicious lesions. Return 1 year.

documents.title: Pulmonary follow-up
documents.author: pulmonology
documents.body:
OUTSIDE PULMONARY & CRITICAL CARE - FOLLOW-UP
Seen by cardiology in March: RV hypertrophy and dilation with tricuspid regurgitation on echo. Breathing at his baseline, edema to the shins as before.
Plan: no medication changes. Right heart catheterization to be arranged before the next visit to measure pulmonary pressures. Return in about 6 months.

documents.title: Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
MEDICARE AWV

Interval: cardiology 3/2024 - tricuspid regurgitation with dilated RV, no changes. ENT finished CT surveillance, now yearly scopes. Derm clean.
Function: independent but slow; groceries delivered now. No falls. Uses portable O2 out of the house.
PHQ-2 0. AUDIT-C 6. Tobacco 1 ppd; counseled; declines.

Exam: SpO2 92% on 2 L. Lungs diminished. Holosystolic murmur LLSB. 1+ edema.

Vaccines: high-dose flu, updated COVID today. Pneumococcal: PPSV23 2018, PCV13 2020 - complete.
Colon: colonoscopy 2016; repeat discussion next year given lungs.
Labs: CMP, CBC, lipids, A1c.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs from Tuesday: kidneys and potassium normal, blood count stable, A1c and cholesterol fine. See you in the spring, sooner if the swelling worsens.
